name: jv5
caption:
PICK 5. THEN WE WAITED A YEAR 🎮🏀

• June 23, 2011: we took Jonas Valančiūnas 5th overall
• He stayed in Lithuania with Lietuvos rytas for one more season and signed with us on July 18, 2012
• 2012-2019: our center
• Feb 7, 2019: he went to Memphis in the Marc Gasol trade. That June, we won the title

Worth the wait? 👇

beats.head: PICK 5
beats.name: JV
beats.vo: We took Jonas Valanciunas fifth overall. Then we waited. A whole year.

beats.head: THE WAIT
beats.name: JV
beats.vo: He played one more season back home in Lithuania, and signed with us in July 2012.
beats.dlg: ONE MORE SEASON AT HOME.|SIGNED: JULY 2012.

beats.head: THE PRICE
beats.name: JV
beats.vo: He was our center until 2019, when he became the price for Marc Gasol. That June, we won it all.
beats.dlg: TRADED FOR MARC GASOL.|THAT JUNE: CHAMPIONS.

beats.head: WORTH IT?
beats.vo: Was pick five worth the wait? Comment below.

facts.claim: Valanciunas was drafted fifth overall (5th, pick 5) by Toronto in the 2011 NBA draft on 23 June 2011 (June 23, 2011); played for Lietuvos rytas 2009-2012 (one more season, 1 more); signed with the Raptors on 18 July 2012 (July 18, 2012); Toronto Raptors 2012-2019; on 7 February 2019 (Feb 7, 2019) traded with C. J. Miles, Delon Wright and a 2024 second-round pick to Memphis for Marc Gasol. ESPN id 6477.
The Raptors won the 2019 NBA Finals in June 2019.
